What's your return and refund policy?
Happy to help. Here is a clear summary of our returns and refunds policy:
Standard returns (UK): Returns are free within the UK. If you return an item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition, we will refund the amount you paid for it.
Sale items: Please register your return within 14 days of receipt via our online returns partner, then you have a further 14 days to send it back in original condition.
How to start a return: Use our online returns partner to register your return and create your label.
Refunds and discounts: Any discount you used is applied per item. You keep the discount on items you keep, and returned items are refunded at the price you paid after the discount.
Exchanges: We do not offer exchanges. Please return your item for a refund and place a new order online for the size or colour you would like.
Non‑refundable items: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Orders with a pre‑order item outstanding: If you return part of an order that still has a pre‑order pending, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund. Any remaining balance will be refunded to your original payment method.
365‑day quality guarantee: After the standard return period (or the sale‑item timelines above), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived. If an item is faulty and returned within 6 months, we will refund it. If returned between 6 and 12 months, we will credit your Boden account for the amount paid; this credit does not expire and can be used on any future order, including sale items. If you purchased with an offer, we will adjust the refund accordingly.
You can find full details on our Returns and refunds page.
